description: Scaffold a new Kotlin Multiplatform mobile app (Android + iOS) at the repository root — Gradle Kotlin DSL wrapper, `settings.gradle.kts`, root `build.gradle.kts`, `gradle.properties` (holding the app version: `VERSION_NAME` `x.y.z[-SNAPSHOT]` + integer `VERSION_CODE`), `gradle/libs.versions.toml`; a `shared/` KMP module on the AGP `com.android.kotlin.multiplatform.library` plugin (`kotlin { android { withHostTest {} } }`) plus `iosArm64` and `iosSimulatorArm64` producing a static `Shared` framework; an `androidApp/` `com.android.application` module (AGP 9 built-in Kotlin, Compose `MainActivity`, env-driven release signing that never fails configuration); and an `iosApp/` SwiftUI host app whose Xcode project is generated by XcodeGen from `iosApp/project.yml` (pre-build phase `./gradlew :shared:embedAndSignAppleFrameworkForXcode`, versions in `iosApp/Configuration/Config.xcconfig`, XCTest `iosAppTests`). `ui: compose` puts a Compose Multiplatform `App()` in `shared/commonMain` (embedded on iOS via `MainViewController()`); `ui: native` keeps `shared` logic-only with Jetpack Compose in `androidApp` and SwiftUI in `iosApp`. Wires everything the KMP gate skills rely on: detekt over every KMP source set, ktlint (`org.jlleitschuh.gradle.ktlint`), Android Lint on `androidApp` and on `shared` (via `com.android.lint`), Kover on both modules aggregated at the root (`./gradlew koverXmlReport` → `build/reports/kover/report.xml`, `koverVerify` at 80% line coverage), Dokka 2 on `shared` (`shared/build/dokka/html`), `iosApp/.swiftlint.yml`, and a root `sonar {}` block (omitted when `sonar: none`), with sample code and tests in every source set (commonTest, androidHostTest, iosTest, androidApp Robolectric, iosAppTests) so coverage starts at 100%, and — per the catalog's UI contract — a `.ui-quality.yml` at the root plus UI test wiring: for `ui: compose` a `commonTest` `uitest/UiScreenshots.kt` helper (Robolectric `UiTest` base on the Android host, PNG capture on both targets, semantics accessibility check) and a `GreetingScreenTest` capturing `.ui-screenshots/screen/GreetingScreen/` across left-to-right/right-to-left × light/dark on Android and iOS; for `ui: native` the same in `androidApp/src/test` (Robolectric + `createComposeRule()`) and an `ImageRenderer` `UIScreenshots.swift` helper + test in `iosAppTests`. Invoke as `/iru-setup-kmp-app`. Accepts pre-resolved inputs via `args` (`key: value` lines) — `ui` (`compose`/`native`), `app-name`, `application-id`, `bundle-id`, `namespace`, `project-name`, `min-sdk`, `compile-sdk`, `target-sdk`, `ios-deployment-target`, `version-name`, `version-code`, `team-id`, `license`, `developer-name`, `developer-email`, `organization-url`, `open-source`, `visibility`, `ci`, `accessibility` (`enforce`/`report`/`off`/`none`, default `enforce` — written to `.ui-quality.yml`), `sonar` (+ `sonar-organization`/ `sonar-project-key`/`sonar-host-url`), `distribution` (`none`/`internal`/`store`), `mode` (`new`/`existing`) and `on-existing` (`ask`/`keep`/`update`/`replace`) — so `iru-setup-kmp-repository` can supply them without re-prompting; stand-alone it asks `open-source` first and derives the `sonar` default from it. Announces whether it is scaffolding from scratch or updating an existing project; for every file group it owns that already exists it warns and asks Update / Keep as is / Replace / Stop (unless `on-existing` decides), never overwrites hand-written source, and treats the JetBrains wizard's older single `composeApp/` layout as foreign (add alongside or stop, never convert). Every version is looked up at run time with a verified October 2026 fallback table. Use whenever a new Kotlin Multiplatform Android + iOS app repository needs its Gradle/Xcode project, quality tooling and tests bootstrapped from this house template.
